retarget.method: Japanese PMX bone semantics and source joint positions map limbs to p0 BNC; continuous native-height torso weights avoid short PMX joint spacing shear. Original AMB drives 30 bones.
retarget.hairBinding: rigid native head approximation, no hair physics
retarget.fingerArticulation: PMX fingers follow native hands; no full MMD finger/morph/IK simulation

provenance.source: User-provided complete Emilia_v1.pmx; source files read-only; no third-party plugin executed.
provenance.face: Complete authored PMX face, mouth, teeth, lashes, eyebrows and eyes retained; no face parts extracted into another model.
provenance.textures: Authored FACE/HAIR/ACCS colors retained, original transparent SDW shading overlay baked over CLOTH to replace duplicate coincident pass. Four runtime textures from five source PNGs. Hair alpha 229..255 treated opaque, not discarded as cutout.
provenance.license: PMX supplies credits but no explicit usage license. Local user-requested conversion only, no upload or redistribution.
limits: No MMD/source-game hair, cloth or rigid-body physics
No MMD facial morph or finger simulation
MMD sphere/toon shading differs from Web PBR

omittedRenderPasses.reason: Coincident Cloth+Skin alpha-color overlay, baked from original SDW over CLOTH; exact matched triangles under 1.907e-6 position/UV tolerance.
